PermissionSet.description: SCRUM-468 AC9/AC9n: the marker set for sales TEAM LEADS only. It carries no object and no field rights at all - a Permission Set can only grant, never revoke, so a second grant set could never make the negative test fail. DemoDevicWriteoffGuard queries PermissionSetAssignment for membership; without it a save that sets Status__c = Written_Off is refused. Assigned to team leads only, read back before handoff.
PermissionSet.label: SCRUM468 Lend Devices - Writeoff marker
